about.title: About Linvoy Academy
about.story: Linvoy Academy was founded on a simple but powerful conviction: every child deserves to be loved, inspired and given a real opportunity to succeed. We are Ghana's only school offering truly holistic Basic Education  combining a rigorous GES-aligned curriculum, French as a dedicated subject at every level, boarding facilities, and values-based character development. We welcome children of every tribe, religion and nationality without exception, because we believe diversity enriches every classroom.
about.mission: Our mission is to obtain success and inspire others to come for proper education. Our vision is a Ghana where every child  regardless of background  has access to world-class, loving, holistic education that shapes not just their career but their character.
about.registration: Linvoy Academy is a duly registered educational institution in the Republic of Ghana. Our curriculum meets national standards set by the Ghana Education Service (GES), and our qualifications are recognised across the country.
about.holistic: We go beyond books. At Linvoy, education means developing the whole child  academically through our rigorous bilingual curriculum, socially through a diverse and inclusive community, physically through sport and activity, and morally through our core values. No other school in Ghana offers this complete package.

boarding.title: Boarding at Linvoy Academy
boarding.subtitle: A safe, nurturing home away from home for students from across Ghana and beyond.
boarding.intro: Our boarding facility is designed with one priority above all others: your child's safety, happiness and growth. Supervised by caring staff around the clock, our boarders enjoy structured study time, healthy meals, recreational activities and a close-knit community that becomes a second family.

features.title: 24/7 Supervision
features.description: Qualified house parents and security staff on site at all times, day and night.

features.title: Healthy Meals
features.description: Three nutritious meals a day prepared fresh on campus, with dietary needs accommodated.

features.title: Structured Study
features.description: Dedicated quiet study hours every evening supported by teachers on duty.

features.title: Recreational Time
features.description: Sports, games, arts and social activities to ensure a balanced, joyful life.

features.title: Pastoral Care
features.description: Regular check-ins, counselling support and open communication with parents.

features.title: Safe & Clean Rooms
features.description: Comfortable, well-maintained dormitories with secure storage for personal belongings.

boarding.eligibility: Boarding is open to all enrolled Linvoy Academy students from Primary school upwards. We welcome both day students transitioning to boarding and new students joining as boarders.
boarding.cta_subtitle: Contact us to arrange a visit or to receive our boarding prospectus.

programs.title: Our Programs
programs.subtitle: A GES-aligned curriculum from Kindergarten through Junior High School — with French taught as a dedicated subject and specialist strands in Languages, Business and Computing.
programs.no_courses: Full programme details coming soon. Contact us for the current prospectus.

levels.label: Kindergarten
levels.description: A nurturing, play-based start to learning. Children develop early literacy and numeracy in English, with French introduced as a fun, dedicated language subject from day one.
highlights: French taught as a subject from KG 1

levels.label: Primary School
levels.description: Six years of solid academic grounding aligned to the Ghana Education Service (GES) curriculum. All core subjects are taught in English, with French as a dedicated subject class throughout all six years.
highlights: French as a dedicated subject — all years

levels.label: Junior High School (JHS)
levels.description: Three years preparing students for the Basic Education Certificate Examination (BECE). Students study a full range of GES subjects in English, with French as a dedicated BECE subject, plus Business and Computing strands.
highlights: Full BECE preparation (all GES core subjects)
Computing & ICT throughout all three years
